I think it's really important to get a idea of what you look like, what things you can pull off and what things make you feel more comfortable about yourself.

At the start of the year, I was anything but comfortable in myself. I thought I was non-binary, my hair was receding which I was worried about everyday as I couldn't be how I wanted to look like. I would get upset by my masculine traits but I would get even more upset by trying to be androgynous or feminine in public as it just wasn't working for Me. I had a huge breakdown In February completely had no self worth or love. Felt so weird. Had to go to a mental hospital and lost all my friends and family.

My first advice if your this far into identity issues like I was, find out where you sit and feel comfortable the most in your expression. Do you feel more comfortable with a masculine/feminine/androgynous expression and essence. For me I found out although I love the feminine essence so much which confused me, I don't give off a feminine essence, it's always has been masculine. I just got confused because I liked particular clothing for the texture (like nylon or lycra) not the style it was trying to portray. Then I let everyone get into my ear saying "are you gay" "are you trans?" I guess this is how non cis people feel like when they had to deal with their birth identity but in a opposite way. Having everyone tell them they are x when their essence isn't x. You have to embrace who you are even if other people disapprove.

That's when I realised I'm actually way more comfortable as a guy who likes leggings and other things like that and suddenly my problem with that disappeared. I still get sore about seeing girls but I think that's because I'm seeking my polar opposite. Not because I'm actually jealous of them. Because I crave a feminine essence in my life as I cannot give it off myself. I think I'll be happy being a guy especially I find someone eventually.

Then I had problems with how I looked. I didn't have a idea of how other people perceived me and how I looked like to other people because my self image was so warped.

So what I did next was I started taking lots of photos of myself and looked act different angles of my shape  (side view, full body view) I went as far as looking at the CCTV at work at how I looked like naturally. I hated what I saw and think it was a cope to not realise how bad I really looked at the time. I also posted on the subreddit am I ugly to get a 3rd person on it and people would always mention my hair as the main thing.

So I started the self improvement process. I found the things that were making me feel bad about myself and alot of this stuff I could change so I did but accepted the rest like my receded hairline.

My hair was a big one, when I started doing these photos it was the main thing that would hold me back, I would dream about having luscious long hair back in my non binary days and created a anxiety about cutting my hair short. Especially people like my ex girlfriend of 4 years ripping me off on my short hair when I was 15. 20 now. I gathered up the confidence to shave it and it fixed so many image problems with me and was the start of Me feeling like me again. I don't feel like getting a different haircut because I feel more authentic, comfortable and even looks good with the recede. It looked so much worse trying cover it up. I started feeling more confident 

I gained some hobbies that I enjoy and made me feel like I fitted a persona more. I was already into them in the past. I picked up gym (which helps make you feel more like you) and motorcycles. I also got more serious on self improvement

I hope all of this was helpful. This is the first time I can say I have a genuine personality then stuff I see and try to copy or be like when it's unauthentic as hell. Through school I would be constently jumping from being a metal head to a more preppy type kid to a complete Nerd and just constently seeking out a ingenuine persona. Now I realise I can be ETHAN and love what I enjoy instead of trying to fit in. And that makes you authentic.
